rect.data-description: the port's A/L (Active/Link) lamp. NO PER-CARD LED TABLE EXISTS for this MPA - the guide gives one for the 20-port GE, the 2-, 4- and 8-port 10GE and both 40GE cards, and none for this one - so the vocabulary here is the family's Table 33, 'Modular Port Adapter LEDs', reduced to the three states its A/L rows name that have a colour: off - port is administratively shut down; green on - link is up; and the down state. Table 33 calls that down state RED where five of the six per-card tables call it AMBER; amber is carried because the majority of the per-card tables in this same family say so, and this is the one place in these seven MPAs where a state colour is a judgement rather than a transcription. Table 33's fourth row, 'Blinking ... The LED blinks green-amber-green', is a modulation of states already named and is not a fourth state. This one is port 0's.

circle.data-description: the MPA's STATUS lamp. Table 33, 'Modular Port Adapter LEDs': off - modular port adapter power is not enabled; red on - has encountered an hardware error; amber on - power is on and there is activity; green on - ready and operational, there is no activity. Four states, transcribed. Note this is the FAMILY table and its STATUS rows are not contradicted by any per-card table, unlike its A/L rows.
